media.title: Roger Féral — portrait photograph
media.altText: Small black-and-white portrait of Roger Féral looking downward, wearing a light jacket and dark tie.
media.publicCaption: Roger Féral (born Roger Boris Lazareff), French lyricist, journalist and playwright.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer and date unidentified; Aristides de Sousa Mendes Foundation, Lazareff/Raudnitz family page.
media.rightsNote: The foundation page identifies Roger Boris Lazareff as Roger Féral and reproduces this portrait, but provides no photographer, date or reuse license. The unchanged low-resolution image is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with attribution and a link to the source page.
